'''X-TR0''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] with a [[Gender/Legends|feminine programming]] used by [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]] to guard the [[Museum/Legends|museum]] on the volcano level of [[The Coil (Obus VI)|The Coil]]. In [[3630 BBY]] X-TR0 detected intruders in the museum and [[Escape from the Coil|attacked]] them, while politely asking them to leave. However, [[HK-55]] and [[Z0-0M]] managed to defeat and destroy her.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
X-TR0 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' during the '''Interlude: Shroud of Memory'''.
